description: Common English labels for analysis work template pages.

messages.Some source columns were not evaluated b: Some source columns were not evaluated because of the input limit.
messages.Some eligible continuous targets were no: Some eligible continuous targets were not evaluated because of the target limit.
messages.Input columns were screened with a bound: Input columns were screened with a bounded probe before applying the model input limit.
messages.The column probe uses an early source sa: The column probe uses an early source sample and may miss later or rare values.
messages.Column probes do not pin a source snapsh: Column probes do not pin a source snapshot across batches.
messages.CI shows the mean and PI an individual o: CI shows the mean and PI an individual observation around the displayed sample's linear trend (95%; independent, normal, constant-variance errors assumed). Red triangles outside PI are review candidates, separate from saved-rule violations.
messages.At least three valid samples with varyin: At least three valid samples with varying X values are required to estimate the boundaries.
messages.Select a point to move to its row in the: Select a point to move to its row in the detail grid.
messages.Red points have an absolute residual gre: Red points have an absolute residual greater than twice the sample MAE. Select a point to move to its row in the detail grid.
messages.Not evaluated by the saved detection run: Not evaluated by the saved detection run because rule rank {rank} exceeded max rules {maxRules}.
Not evaluated by the saved detection run because it did not meet the confidence or lift criteria.
messages.No violation rows were stored by the sam: No violation rows were stored by the sampled detection result. Use Realtime to check the full current target table.
messages.These are violation rows stored by the s: These are violation rows stored by the sampled detection result.
messages.Rule condition or Target Table informati: Rule condition or Target Table information required for realtime lookup is missing.
messages.Select a node to highlight its direct co: Select a node to highlight its direct connections.
messages.Apriori generation was not hard-filtered: Apriori generation was not hard-filtered by cluster; this is reference lineage.
messages.Selected features and R2 satisfy the sym: Selected features and R² satisfy the symbolic formula criteria.
messages.LASSO R2 {r2} is below the formula thres: LASSO R² {r2} is below the formula threshold {minR2}.
messages.Automatic target order {order} exceeds t: Automatic target order {order} exceeds the maximum {maxTargets}.
messages.No non-zero LASSO feature was selected f: No non-zero LASSO feature was selected for this target.
messages.No LASSO target result was generated wit: No LASSO target result was generated within the eligible automatic range.
messages.No relation pairs for the selected filte: No relation pairs for the selected filter.
messages.Stored as PASS_YN=N by the analysis proc: Stored as PASS_YN=N by the analysis procedure.
messages.Select at least one cluster to display t: Select at least one cluster to display the graph.
messages.Rule model R² is below 0.70. Treat this: Rule model R² is below 0.70. Treat this formula as an exploratory pattern, not a stable operating rule.
messages.Rule model and current sample R² differ: Rule model and current sample R² differ by {gap}. Check sampling, distribution shift, and overfitting.
messages.Formula term count is high ({complexity}: Formula term count is high ({complexity}). Prefer a simpler rule unless independent validation shows a material gain.
messages.This polynomial fallback formula contain: This polynomial fallback formula contains {complexity} terms. Review its validation gain before operational use.
messages.The current sample shows directional bia: The current sample shows directional bias: mean residual is {bias}, or {ratio} of MAE.
messages.Observed maximum relative error {error}: Observed maximum relative error {error} exceeds the allowed relative error {tolerance}.
messages.{count} rows exceed the allowed relative: {count} rows exceed the allowed relative error for this rule.
messages.No immediate warning was found in the av: No immediate warning was found in the available diagnostics. Confirm the formula with independent validation data before operational use.
messages.These rules explain Isolation Forest can: These rules explain Isolation Forest candidates. Agreement measures model consistency, not confirmed errors.
messages.Counts are rule-row matches; one row may: Counts are rule-row matches; one row may match several rules. Only a bounded preview is stored.
messages.First-row sampling may reflect source or: First-row sampling may reflect source ordering.
No saved candidate rows for this rule.
messages.Select a rule to inspect its conditions,: Select a rule to inspect its conditions, result and matching rows.
messages.Click a legend to filter rules: Click a legend to filter rules
messages.Inspect the rules explaining anomaly can: Inspect the rules explaining anomaly candidates and their matching rows.
messages.Rule summary is unavailable. Reload afte: Rule summary is unavailable. Reload after restarting the backend.
messages.Stop requested. The current task will fi: Stop requested. The current task will finish before the pipeline stops.
messages.Pause requested. The current task will f: Pause requested. The current task will finish before the pipeline pauses.
messages.Paused. Resume continues from the next u: Paused. Resume continues from the next unfinished stage.
messages.Stopped. Restart runs the saved FLOW fro: Stopped. Restart runs the saved FLOW from the beginning.
messages.Matches the anomaly explanation rule; re: Matches the anomaly explanation rule; requires review.
messages.Actual value does not satisfy the expect: Actual value does not satisfy the expected value or range.
messages.The result value is missing and does not: The result value is missing and does not satisfy the rule.
messages.These rules predict actual column values: These rules predict actual column values or ranges. Violations satisfy IF but do not satisfy THEN; they require review.
messages.No patterns passed the support, confiden: No patterns passed the support, confidence and validation criteria. No rules were forced.
messages.Validation metrics were used for rule se: Validation metrics were used for rule selection; they are not independent final test metrics.
messages.Rules predict actual column values or ra: Rules predict actual column values or ranges without a manual type-classification stage.
messages.Inspect expected values, confidence and: Inspect expected values, confidence and rows that violate the IF–THEN patterns.
messages.Confidence, support and lift use the ful: Confidence, support and lift use the full target data after detection.
No saved violation rows for this rule.
messages.IF is satisfied but THEN is not satisfie: IF is satisfied but THEN is not satisfied.
messages.Target-column limits were applied. Only: Target-column limits were applied. Only the listed target columns were modeled.
messages.Columns excluded by the feature limit: Columns excluded by the feature limit
messages.The rule limit was applied; additional p: The rule limit was applied; additional patterns may exist.
messages.The actual value is outside the formula: The actual value is outside the formula prediction tolerance.
messages.Formula confidence is the fraction withi: Formula confidence is the fraction within tolerance, not association frequency. R² and MAE use rows with finite observations and predictions; missing results still violate the rule.
messages.This stage was not stored in this execut: This stage was not stored in this execution. Existing two-stage history is preserved; run a new four-stage FLOW to create it.
messages.Statistics and relationships describe th: Statistics and relationships describe the saved bounded sample, not the entire source or a causal relationship.
messages.Rules predict actual column values, rang: Rules predict actual column values, ranges and formulas after basic statistics and relationship analysis.
messages.These rules predict actual column values: These rules predict actual column values, ranges or formulas. Violations satisfy IF but do not satisfy THEN; they require review.
messages.Reported rule metrics use the same full: Reported rule metrics use the same full target cohort after detection.
messages.Nonfinite values were excluded from nume: Nonfinite values were excluded from numeric statistics.
messages.Some statistics exceed the representable: Some statistics exceed the representable range and are unavailable.
messages.Mixed value, range and formula rules: Mixed value, range and formula rules
Continuous formula rules were generated. They are separated from value and range rules.
messages.Continuous formula discovery was disable: Continuous formula discovery was disabled for this execution.
messages.This historical execution has no saved c: This historical execution has no saved continuous-discovery diagnostics. Run a new execution to evaluate formulas.
messages.No eligible continuous target columns we: No eligible continuous target columns were found in the saved sample.
messages.No continuous formulas passed the saved: No continuous formulas passed the saved validation criteria. No formulas were forced.
messages.Formula validation and saved per-row pre: Formula validation and saved per-row predictions are shown below. A source-sample chart is not available for this stored result.
messages.Strict numeric text was interpreted nume: Strict numeric text was interpreted numerically; the physical database type is unchanged.
messages.Too few fit or calibration rows: Too few fit or calibration rows
messages.Numeric-text inference was not recorded: Numeric-text inference was not recorded in this older execution.
messages.Validated formulas were found but exclud: Validated formulas were found but excluded by the final rule-count limit.
messages.Reason counts refer to excluded columns: Reason counts refer to excluded columns or rejected candidates, not source rows.
No data is available for this chart.
Formula sample query context is missing.
Formula chart resources are unavailable. Refresh the page and try again.
messages.Current source sample could not be loade: Current source sample could not be loaded.
messages.Invalid numeric text was excluded from n: Invalid numeric text was excluded from numeric statistics; original values are preserved.
messages.HASH samples reduce source-order bias bu: HASH samples reduce source-order bias but are not stratified; source snapshots are not pinned.
messages.Hash sampling requires a count and a sou: Hash sampling requires a count and a source scan.
messages.The sample byte limit reduced the stored: The sample byte limit reduced the stored hash sample; it may not represent the source.
messages.Hash filtering returned fewer rows than: Hash filtering returned fewer rows than the requested sample size.
messages.The source row count changed during samp: The source row count changed during sampling; statistics do not represent a fixed snapshot.
messages.Flow execution completed. {executed} nod: Flow execution completed. {executed} node(s) executed, {skipped} skipped.
Flow execution completed with failures. {succeeded} node(s) succeeded, {failed} failed, {skipped} skipped.
